header.title: Cost pressures prompt notebook production to reshore from emerging locations back to China

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce estimates the share of global notebook production outside China falling from ~24% in 2025 to 21% in 2026 and potentially below 20% in 2027 as cost and efficiency outweigh policy-risk diversification. ⟨cited figures: approximate; forecast⟩
If tariffs don't intensify, brands may relocate some capacity established outside China back to the country, reassessing diversification vs manufacturing efficiency. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
A reversal of production diversification back to China would favor China-based capacity over emerging-location sites, though the article names no companies for either side.
